purpose: Maps visible implementation-specific states to canonical language without pretending that two persistence layers are the same thing.

states.meaning: No user project has been opened; the demo context must not be presented as a portable project.
The current demo-plan operation journal reports ready. It is not proof of portable .arq publication.
A local journal append is in progress.
The local journal is unavailable or a write failed; current edits may not be persisted in that journal.
The current demo-plan state was replayed from the local journal.
The file passed compatibility preflight; it is not a live open project in the current implementation.
Use only if a readable project session was actually created. Otherwise describe the compatibility or recovery outcome instead.
